text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haaah... What should I do~~?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
……Now that's an obvious way to be 
depressed.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-chan!? Oh no, did you hear that?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Sitting on a swing and sighing... ...How 
cliché.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You know... I'm taking a break from being 
a big sister right now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You? Well, that's rare.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"My twin little sisters, you see~ ended up 
getting into a huge fight because of me."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
They haven't spoken to me for three whole 
days! Big sis is suuuper crushed...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mom said that since she's feeling 
sensitive right now, even contacting her 
on LANE is forbidden!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...What did you do?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I sent that wacky keychain Helios-chan 
gave me back home to my family.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And then, they ended up fighting over 
it... That keychain of the Wind God that 
looked like a little demon.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Did you just smile?! Ayabe-chan, you 
smiled, didn't you~?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not laughing. I just let my guard 
down.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"They wanted it because it carries your 
name. ...You really are quite adored, 
aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh...!! I-Is that what you mean!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't you be proud as an older sister? 
...Why do you need to feel down about it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I see... Oh, I get it now! I'm feeling all 
energized all of a sudden!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I ended up leaning on you. 
Ayabe-chan, you're just like a big sister.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Silly. I'm no match for you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Take good care of your little sister.
